name: interferon regulatory factor 1

function.text: IRF1 encodes interferon regulatory factor 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
